title: Not using `SafeTransferLib`
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  Most of the token transfer operations within the `Pool` already utilize `SafeTransferLib`. However, several operations, including those in `removeLiquidity`, `rescue`, and `skim`, still use the unsafe transfer method. Consider adjusting these transfer operations to also utilize `SafeTransferLib`.  The rescue function is designed to withdraw all tokens mistakenly sent to the contract, excluding the supported tokens listed in the tokens array.
